meta.name: add-karpathy-llm-wiki
meta.description: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to a NanoClaw group. Based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern. Triggers on "add wiki", "wiki", "knowledge base", "llm wiki", "karpathy wiki".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为群组添加持久化知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在群聊中共享和查询持久化的知识库内容。
copy.tagline_en: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to your group
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to share and query a persistent knowledge base in group chats.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会在你指定的群组里建立并维护一个持久维基知识库:创建目录并写入索引、日志和一套维护规则。你发来材料时,它会逐份阅读并更新维基,而不是囫囵吞枣;还能按约定定期检查维基质量。
howto.when: 当你说出“add wiki”“wiki”“knowledge base”等关键词,或要求给某个群添加维基知识库时触发。

say.text: 给这个群建一个wiki,存我们讨论过的产品点子。
say.note: 它会开始规划目录和规则,并让你确认群组。

say.text: 把这份PDF加入wiki,并总结要点。
say.note: 它会读文件、更新索引和日志。

say.text: 建wiki时,设成每周自动检查维基质量。
say.note: 它会定时清理和检查维基链接。

howto.what_en: Sets up a persistent wiki in a NanoClaw group: creates folders and initial files, a container skill for maintenance, and a CLAUDE.md section. Then maintains the wiki one source at a time, updating pages; optionally schedules lint checks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions 'add wiki', 'wiki', 'knowledge base' or similar, or asks to add a wiki knowledge base to a group.

say_en.text: Set up a wiki for this group to save our product ideas.
say_en.note: It starts planning structure and asks which group.

say_en.text: Add this PDF to the wiki and summarize its points.
say_en.note: It reads the file and updates the index and logs.

say_en.text: During setup, make it check wiki quality weekly.
say_en.note: It schedules periodic cleanup and link review.
